context.name: Context
context.audience: Anyone new to GOV.UK Chat, including non-engineers
context.blurb: GOV.UK Chat among the systems around it: the app a question is typed into, the AWS services that answer it, and the private repository that holds every prompt. C4 level 1 — runtime only.
context.note: Which caller reaches this system is not provable from either repository: the app backend forwards to whatever an SSM parameter names. Everything else here is read from this repository's own code.
context.dashMeans: a dependency resolved when the agent is built, not a call it makes

tables.name: The four stacks, and which agent answers which API

resources.name: Resources
resources.audience: Cost, audit and incident scoping — the detail behind every badge
resources.blurb: Every AWS resource the CDK app declares, counted per environment by reading the constructs.
resources.note: Counts are read from the source, not synthesised. This repository's CDK app bundles every agent in Docker against a private git dependency, so nothing outside its own CI can synthesise it — which is also why no count here is gated by a build. Environments are ephemeral by default: only stag and prod are durable, and every other name, including a developer's own, gets its own copy of all four stacks.
